name: Solwata
summary:
Solwata (pidgin for saltwater) is an immersive mixed reality experience that transports audiences to Solomon Islands to confront the human rights consequences of climate change. Co-produced by Human Rights Watch, NowHere Media, and Agog: The Immersive Media Institute, the project is based on Human Rights Watch research and created with the Walande, Ngongosila, and Kwai communities.
